blurb: Guests fish in the Back Bay of Biloxi and offshore waters targeting species like red drum, black drum, trout, flounder, sheepshead, cobia, sharks, and more. Trips range from 3 to 8 hours and include fishing near structures, islands, reefs, and open waters. The captain provides bait and fishing gear and shares extensive local knowledge.
extraNote: $150 deposit required to book offshore trip · Boat ramp in Biloxi Back Bay
